VERDICT: FAIL

The evidence confirms criterion (2)—all 72 tests pass—but provides no proof for criterion (1), that the duplicate-send bug is actually fixed. Passing tests only demonstrate the bug is fixed if there is a specific test that reproduces the duplicate-send condition and now passes. No such test, diff, or root-cause explanation is shown, so the core defect could remain unaddressed. Additional evidence (the failing-then-passing regression test, or the code change) is needed before this can pass.
